lead: Sulakshana Pandit was an Indian actor, born on 12 July 1954 in Raigarh.
She died on 6 November 2025 in Mumbai at the age of 71.
She has 14 credited works on public record and has been recognised with the Filmfare Awards.

sections.heading: Sulakshana Pandit — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sulakshana Pandit was born on 12 July 1954 in Raigarh, and holds Indian nationality. She was given the name Sulakshana Pratap Narain Pandit at birth and is publicly known as Sulakshana Pandit.
Public records name her father, Pratap Narayan. She is a sibling of Jatin Pandit, Vijayta Pandit, Lalit Pandit and Mandheer Pandit.
She is recorded as speaking Hindi.
